clip.use: Moving footage from the pool - the default B-roll. Calm templates open on it.

photo.use: A photograph with a slow camera move (move=in/out/left/right/up, focus, zoom); can carry chip / lower / place overlays.

depth.use: Depth pop: the subject is cut out of the photo and grows while the ground darkens and blurs. Use when the narration names a real person, place or object - never private people.

spotlight.use: Everything but one circle darkens and blurs; a label points at the subject. 'Look here' moments: the detail that matters in a photo.

tv.use: The picture plays inside an old TV set and the camera pushes into the screen. 'Back then', archive, broadcast, 'on the news' moments. Mark archive shots archive=True to also get the vintage TV-gate overlay.

card.use: A document, scan, letter or clipping held as a card with a slow zoom: records, evidence, official papers.

split.use: Two pictures side by side with labels: before / after, then / now, A vs B.

collage.use: Paper tabletop: photo prints (pc), cut-out props (cutout), typed strips, rubber stamps, sticky notes, circles and arrows - each lands on its word. The workhorse of the paper look: most explanations happen here.

newspaper.use: A newspaper page with headline and photo; the camera moves into the article. 'It was reported that...'.

headlines.use: Headlines slam in one after another - 'everyone reported it', a wave of coverage.

baskets.use: Claims sorted into folders: known / claimed / unknown. The video's argument made visible.

chapter.use: Full-screen chapter card: number, kicker, title. One per act.

words.use: Kinetic type: one to three big words slam in on the beat (items=[W_('...')]). The punch of a sentence, the question, the twist.

title.use: The title card of the video.

stat.use: One big number that counts up, with a kicker and a note. Every important figure the narrator says.

quote.use: A quotation set large with who said it and highlighted words. Every time the script quotes someone.

ledger.use: An account that adds up line by line to a total: costs, counts, a running sum.

timeline.use: Dates on a line; events appear in order. Any 'in 1990... by 2000... today' passage.

measure.use: A size comparison: the object against a known scale (people, buses, football fields).

checklist.use: Points ticked off one by one: requirements, reasons, steps, 'three things...'.

geo.use: A terrain / satellite close-up of a region with labels and a profile: mountains, valleys, where exactly.

map.use: The animated map: the camera flies between places, pins drop, routes draw, regions light up. Every place the narration names gets one (group nearby places into one map scene).

doctitle.use: Calm chapter title over a darkened photo: 'Chapter N' + serif title + sub.

textcard.use: One to three calm lines over a darkened photo: the key sentence of a passage.

ledgerlist.use: A household ledger that writes in line by line.

sizechart.use: Bars that grow with family size against one fixed income line.

filter.use: Claims fall through a filter into OBSERVED / CLAIMED / CONFIRMED.

gauge.use: A certainty ring that falls from 100 % - how sure can we be.

network.use: Many reports traced back to a single source.

valley.use: A cross-section / terrain profile of where something lies.

cells.use: A grid of cells filling to show a proportion.

scales.use: Scales of justice tipping as each piece of evidence is weighed.

scoreboard.use: A split-flap scoreboard: for and against.

verdict.use: The final verdict stamp: REALITY / MYTH. Once, at the end.

breaking.use: BREAKING NEWS slab with the headline - the open and every big reveal.

echo.use: A wall of headlines that collapses to one source.

videowall.use: A wall of screens; one pushes in to full frame.

newslist.use: A numbered news list with status tags.

segment.use: Segment bumper between parts of the show.

gzcard.use: A key point on a ledger slip (punched holes, double keyline) over a dimmed photo.

gzstat.use: One figure stamped between two hairlines with a pencil note.

gzversus.use: Two things compared row by row (people / places / districts); each value counts up on its own word.

gzgiants.use: One circle sized by its value beside a field of small dots - one big thing against many small ones.

gzdivide.use: One cell inside a boundary dividing into 2, 3, 10 - growth by division.

gzindex.use: Gazetteer index rows: name, dotted leader, figure; one row highlighted.

gzdelta.use: Then -> now with an arrow and the difference stamped (2015 -> 2025).

almgrowth.use: A line drawn across years on paper; each point appears on its words.

almsplit.use: A field fenced into equal strips: one whole divided among many.

almdots.use: Rows of dots: generations, multiplication, 1 dot = N people.

almshare.use: One bar split into shares that grow in turn: 'more than half...'.

almbars.use: Columns that rise to their values on paper.

almdistrict.use: A ring of houses around a centre, with roles as tags: a community and its structure.

ov:chip.use: A label chip that wipes in: a name, a date, a place, a figure.

ov:place.use: Location caption with a thin rule (documentary).

ov:gzhead.use: Chapter heading stamped over MOVING footage: plate stamp, engraved title, pencil note. One per act.

ov:gztag.use: Place cartouche over footage: where we are.

ov:ticker.use: News ticker crawling at the bottom.
